Chapter 1290: 37: Is This Enough?

Chapter 1290: Chapter 37: Is This Enough?

The grand hall at the peak of Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

The Sect Master of the Holy Sect was in seclusion cultivating, while also constantly observing the situation beyond the sacred mountain.

Lin Yuan had told him that the Eternal Envoy would arrive soon.

The Sect Master of the Holy Sect naturally had absolute faith in Lin Yuan’s words.

Hence, he was already prepared to welcome the Eternal Envoy at any moment.

Although under Lin Yuan’s protection, the Sect Master of the Holy Sect no longer placed much importance on the aid of the Eternal Envoy,

behind the Eternal Envoy stood the power of the Eternal Sect, which is composed of the Eternal Lord.

It was not to be underestimated.

“I wonder what the elder wishes to discuss with the Eternal Envoy?”

The Sect Master of the Holy Sect was quite curious.

Lin Yuan had instructed him to inform him once the Eternal Envoy arrived.

This meant that Lin Yuan wished to engage in a dialogue with the Eternal Envoy.

“Let’s wait then.”

The Sect Master of the Holy Sect gazed toward the center of the heavens, patiently awaiting the arrival of the Eternal Envoy.

What the Sect Master of the Holy Sect didn’t know was that the Eternal Envoy he awaited,

had already been swept away by Lin Yuan without the slightest struggle.

The Eternal Envoys, who could intimidate numerous Holy Sects and the Supreme Saint Sect, seemed like ants before Lin Yuan.

…

Deep within the Qingyun Institute.

The silver-eyed man and the three Eternal Envoys were like facing a formidable foe, watching Lin Yuan seated cross-legged not far away.

The true forms of the three Eternal Envoys outside the Qingyun Sacred Mountain were easily swept here without resistance. This made the silver-eyed man realize that the young man before him was far beyond what he could handle.

As a powerful cultivator of the Third Realm of Freedom, even if he wasn’t a match for the Eternal Son, shouldn’t he be this vulnerable?

Lin Yuan felt to them like a Source Demon.

If not for the complete absence of Demonic Qi emanating from him, the three Eternal Envoys might really have believed they were facing an extremely formidable Source Demon.

The Source Demon is a being second only to a Demon God, and among Source Demons, there are varying levels of strength, with the most powerful being capable of shaking the foundations of the Eternal Sect.

“May I ask what you intend to do?”

After a moment, the silver-eyed man spoke with bravado.

Through a brief standoff, he had reached some conclusions.

For instance, the young man before them likely harbored no deadly intent towards them.

Otherwise, since he could sweep them up with one hand, he could also extinguish them with the same ease.

Thus, the silver-eyed man’s tone was very humble, lacking any airs of an Eternal Envoy.

“I wish to make a transaction with your major Eternal Sects.”

Lin Yuan said with a smile.

He had long wanted to contact the Eternal Sect.

It’s just that with the Demon God stationed at the center of the heavens, he had refrained from getting too close.

Now that the Eternal Envoy had approached on his own, Lin Yuan decided to take the opportunity to negotiate.

“A transaction with the sect?”

The silver-eyed man looked at Lin Yuan.

To directly propose a transaction with the Eternal Sect was incredibly audacious.

What kind of entity is the Eternal Sect? Even during the current era of the ‘Demon’ calamity, it remains supreme, having measures left by various Eternal Lords to restrain the most powerful ‘Demon God’.

Yet remembering how Lin Yuan had just transported them to this place, the silver-eyed man dared not say much.

“What kind of transaction?”

The silver-eyed man asked with a deep voice.

“I want all the symbolic legacies of the Eternal Sect, including those established by the Eternal Lords, as well as all information and intelligence concerning ‘Demons’, especially about that Demon God.”

Lin Yuan stated directly.

So far, he obtained only the symbolic legacies left by two Eternal Lords.

To be precise, just one.

Regarding the symbolic legacy left by the Lord of Heaven Light, he had acquired only one type.

He had obtained the entire legacy left by the Master of Wushan, but precisely because of this,

Lin Yuan craved the symbolic legacies of the other Eternal Lords even more.

Especially that of the Lord of Heaven Light.

The understanding this Eternal Lord had of runes was astounding even to Lin Yuan.

He wished to comprehend more.

“All symbolic legacies?”

The silver-eyed man took a deep breath.

After the ‘Demon’ calamity descended, each major Eternal Sect had already relaxed their own access to symbolic legacies.

Even so, ordinary disciples had to pay a price to comprehend profound symbolic legacies.

Particularly, the core symbolic legacies of the Eternal Sect could only be comprehended by the Eternal Son.

Yet Lin Yuan outright demanded all symbolic legacies?

“I can’t make that decision.”

The silver-eyed man immediately said.

The two Eternal Envoys behind him also nodded.

They were only Eternal Envoys, not even the Eternal Son, and couldn’t represent the Eternal Sect behind them.

“I understand.”

Lin Yuan looked at the three Eternal Envoys, his tone calm, “So now, you should directly contact the Sect Master and have him negotiate with me.”

Upon saying this,

The silver-eyed man’s face was filled with astonishment.

To directly contact the Sect Master, he indeed could do that, but how did Lin Yuan know?

He was unaware that after thoroughly refining the azure communication rune, Lin Yuan possessed ‘supreme authority’ equivalent to an Eternal Lord, familiar with all the uses and functions of such communication runes.

Among these was contacting the Sect Master.

Had it not been for the concern that directly contacting might cause some fright, Lin Yuan would have directly contacted the Sect Master of the Eternal Sect himself.

“Okay.”

After hesitating for a while, the silver-eyed man nodded and said.

Lin Yuan’s power was beyond imagination, nearly matching the oppressive aura of a Source Demon.

Such a powerful cultivator indeed warranted reporting to the Sect Master.

After a brief pause, the silver-eyed man took out the azure rune.

Stretching out his hand, he activated it.

Instantly, the azure rune quivered slightly.

Countless tiny runes within swiftly spun around, and following some invisible resonance, shot toward the center of the heavens in an instant.
